name: bitquery_dex_trades
description: Recent DEX trades for a token — swaps involving an ERC-20 token across DEXs on an EVM chain (Bitquery). Returns trade time, DEX/protocol, buy & sell currency + amounts, price, tx hash, and maker. Example: bitquery_dex_trades({ token: "0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7", network: "eth", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-bitquery-token" })

network.description: EVM network enum (default "eth"). Options: eth, bsc, matic, arbitrum, base, optimism, avalanche, fantom, cronos, gnosis, klaytn, moonbeam, opbnb.

_apiKey.description: Bitquery OAuth access token (Bearer). Generate at bitquery.io (free Developer tier).

name: bitquery_token_transfers
description: Recent transfers of a token — ERC-20 transfer events for a token contract on an EVM chain (Bitquery). Returns transfer time, sender, receiver, amount, and tx hash. Example: bitquery_token_transfers({ token: "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48", network: "eth", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-bitquery-token" })

network.description: EVM network enum (default "eth"). See bitquery_dex_trades for options.

_apiKey.description: Bitquery OAuth access token (Bearer). Generate at bitquery.io (free Developer tier).

name: bitquery_token_holders
description: Top holders of a token — largest current balances for an ERC-20 token contract on an EVM chain (Bitquery Holders cube). Returns holder address and balance. Optionally scope to a snapshot date. Example: bitquery_token_holders({ token: "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48", network: "eth", limit: 20, _apiKey: "your-bitquery-token" })

network.description: EVM network enum (default "eth"). See bitquery_dex_trades for options.

date.description: Optional snapshot date "YYYY-MM-DD" — filters to balances last changed on/before this date. Omit for the latest snapshot.

_apiKey.description: Bitquery OAuth access token (Bearer). Generate at bitquery.io (free Developer tier).
